Group learning_curves.csv by replicate_id and condition and draw cumulative best observed scores. The three naive_seed runs are naive_1 through naive_3; the three two_dimensional_champion runs are transfer_1 through transfer_3. Iterations 0-39 use historical observations; iteration 40 is max(iteration39_best, all four terminal candidate plotted_score values). The three supporting tables give the full adopted candidate batch, endpoint calculations and point-level origins; they do not add plotted curves. All three runs per condition are shown; the thick curve is the mean and the shaded interval is the min-max range, not a confidence interval.
